verdict.rationale: ImageMagick documents one-line conversion commands such as `magick input.png -quality 85 output.webp`, has an officially documented CLI, and markets a scripting-first design for batch jobs. Community users confirm writing bash scripts around it and praise its short one-liners. missing for 10: explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of use in CI pipelines specifically.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI

citations.quote: CLI & Automation Scripting-first design for mass batch jobs.
write a bash script that scaled and centered thousands of images into gallery thumbnails
